Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 FP8 使用指南

Qwen-图像-编辑-2511是阿里巴巴Qwen团队发布的最新图像编辑模型。与之前的版本相比，它在以下方面进行了重大改进：字符一致性, 多人编辑, 和遵循指令.

1. 快速入门指南

要在 ComfyUI 或类似工作流程中使用此模型，请按照以下步骤操作：

  • 模型安装:

    • 放置下载好的FP8主要型号（例如，qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors）进入你的ComfyUI/模型/diffusion_models/目录。

    • 确保您有兼容的CLIP/文本编码器（推荐：qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled）和VAE安装的型号。

  • 主要特点:

    • 基于指令的编辑：使用自然语言修改图像（例如，“将角色的服装更改为红色”或“在背景中添加日落”）。

    • 字符一致性：在改变环境或动作的同时，完美保持原有的面部特征。

    • 高速采样：当与闪电LoRA，只需 4-8 个步骤即可生成高质量结果。

  • 操作技巧:

    • 输入图像：上传您要编辑的源图片。

    • 提示：输入清晰简洁的编辑指令。

    • CFG规模：对于 FP8 型号，请将 CFG 保留在1.0 - 1.5（使用 Lightning LoRA 时）或遵循默认工作流程设置。

Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 FP8 Usage Guide

Qwen-Image-Edit-2511is the latest image editing model released by the Alibaba Qwen team. Compared to previous versions, it offers significant improvements incharacter consistency, multi-person editing, andinstruction following.

1. Quick Start Guide

To use this model in ComfyUI or similar workflows, follow these steps:

  • Model Installation:

    • Place the downloadedFP8 Main Model(e.g.,qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors) into yourComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/directory.

    • Ensure you have the compatibleCLIP/Text Encoder(recommended:qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled) andVAEmodels installed.

  • Key Features:

    • Instruction-Based Editing: Modify images using natural language (e.g., "Change the character's outfit to red" or "Add a sunset to the background").

    • Character Consistency: Perfectly maintains original facial features while modifying environments or actions.

    • High-Speed Sampling: When paired withLightning LoRA, it generates high-quality results in just 4–8 steps.

  • Operational Tips:

    • Input Image: Upload the source image you wish to edit.

    • Prompt: Enter clear and concise editing instructions.

    • CFG Scale: For FP8 models, keep CFG between1.0 - 1.5(when using Lightning LoRA) or follow the default workflow settings.

2. Hugging Face Download Links

  • Recommended FP8 Quantized Version (by xms991): https://huggingface.co/xms991/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-fp8-e4m3fn

  • Official Model Weights (BF16): https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511

  • Lightning Optimized Version (by lightx2v): https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning/tree/main
